title: Specification of list compilation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $cs$ a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. Suppose that every $c$ in $cs$, when compiled after any acyclic gate list $gs$, satisfies the single-circuit compilation specification: the compiled list extends $gs$ and is acyclic; its root index is below $n$ plus the resulting list length; its root value agrees with $c$ under every variable assignment; its length is at most $|gs|$ plus the size of $c$; its root depth is at most the depth of $c$ plus $1$; and its new gates have distinct inputs, every NOT gate has one input, and each new gate has at most $\max(1,F)$ inputs, where $F$ is the maximum fanin of $c$. Then, for every acyclic initial gate list $gs$, compiling all of $cs$ appends a gate list and produces a list of root vertices of the same length as $cs$. The resulting gate list is acyclic and extends $gs$; every root index is below $n$ plus the resulting list length, and under each variable assignment the root values, in order, equal the evaluations of the circuits in $cs$. The resulting gate list has length at most $|gs|$ plus the sum of the circuit sizes in $cs$, and every root has depth at most the maximum circuit depth in $cs$ plus $1$. Each new gate has distinct inputs, every NOT gate has one input, and each new gate has at most $\max(1,F)$ inputs, where $F$ is the maximum fanin among circuits in $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
Each circuit in $cs$ has the stated single-circuit compilation specification for every acyclic initial gate list
$gs$ is an acyclic initial gate list
